pairs.target: nài lěi de wūlǐ duō le yìzhī biě zhěntou .
pairs.english: A flat pillow had appeared in Nerai’s room.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的屋里多了一只瘪枕头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gétiān sònghuán gōng duì jiè de mù jiá , kànjiàn zhěntou gē zài yǐ shàng , yìjiǎo xì zhe jié , xiàng yǒurén xián tā tàipàng , yìng bǎ lǐmiàn yíbàn dōngxī jǐzǒu .
pairs.english: The next day Tavi returned the crew’s borrowed wooden clips and saw the pillow on a chair, one corner knotted as though somebody thought it too fat and forced half its filling out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维隔天送还工队借的木夹，看见枕头搁在椅上，一角系着结，像有人嫌它太胖，硬把里面一半东西挤走。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhèng zuòzài dìshàng chāi xuē dài , tīngjiàn tā xiào , shuō nà búshì gěi rén kàn de , shì gěi yāo kàn de .
pairs.english: Nerai was sitting on the floor undoing bootlaces. Hearing him laugh, she said it was for her back, not for people to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾正坐在地上拆靴带，听见他笑，说那不是给人看的，是给腰看的。

pairs.target: tā qiántiān huí de tóng jiē . yuánxiān dǎsuàn duō chá liǎngtiān , hòulái yòu liú le sāntiān , děng liǎngcì bùtóng shuǐwèi xià de dúshù dōu jì wán , cái tóng zhàn shàngjiāo qīng .
pairs.english: She had returned to Copperstep two days earlier. Planning two more inspection days, she had stayed another three, waiting for readings at two different water levels before completing the station handover.
pairs.hanzi: 她前天回的铜阶。原先打算多查两天，后来又留了三天，等两次不同水位下的读数都记完，才同站上交清。

pairs.target: jiù péng de fànwéi réng wéizhe , páng qú yòng mù dǎng , shuí zhíshǒu , shuí qīnglǐ , yǐjīng pái hǎo . xīn de héngtiáo hé kòujiàn liúzài gān péng , búshì bái zuò , què hái méiyǒu zhuāng dào yuánlái yào zhuāng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The old shed area remained cordoned off; the side channel used wooden barriers, with watch and cleaning duties assigned. The new crossbars and clasps waited in a dry shed, useful work, but not yet fitted where intended.
pairs.hanzi: 旧棚的范围仍围着，旁渠用木挡，谁值守、谁清理，已经排好。新的横条和扣件留在干棚，不是白做，却还没有装到原来要装的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nàxiē zuò wán de dōngxī huì buhuì ràng rén suàn chéng méi zuò . tā táitóu kàn tā , shuō ruì shīfu jiāo de biǎo fēnkāi xiě le , gōngqián zěnme liè , zuótiān yě hé guò , búhuì bǎ tā de shǒu mǒdiào .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if the finished work would count as undone. She looked up and said Master Rui’s sheets listed it separately; wages had been checked yesterday too, and his work would not be erased.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问那些做完的东西会不会让人算成没做。她抬头看他，说芮师傅交的表分开写了，工钱怎么列，昨天也核过，不会把他的手抹掉。

pairs.target: tā yǒuxiē bùhǎoyìsi , shuō zìjǐ búshì zhī wèn qián . nài lěi shuō zhīdào , kě wèn qián yě méiyǒu shénme bùhǎo .
pairs.english: A little embarrassed, he said he was not asking only about money. Nerai said she knew, but there was nothing wrong with asking about money too.
pairs.hanzi: 他有些不好意思，说自己不是只问钱。奈蕾说知道，可问钱也没有什么不好。

pairs.target: xuē dài zuìhòu yígè jié bèi ní yǎo sǐ . tā chě le yíxià , méi kāi , shēnshǒu xiàng tā yào xiǎodāo . tā ná chūlái , què xiān wèn néng bunéng shì zhe jiě .
pairs.english: Mud had locked the last knot. She tugged without loosening it and asked for his knife. He produced it, but first asked if he could try untying it.
pairs.hanzi: 靴带最后一个结被泥咬死。她扯了一下，没开，伸手向他要小刀。他拿出来，却先问能不能试着解。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xuēzǐ tuīguòqù , zìjǐ kào dào yǐ biān , yòng nà zhī biě zhěntou diàn zhù yāo , chángcháng chū le yìkǒuqì .
pairs.english: She pushed the boot toward him and leaned against the chair, padding her back with the flat pillow and releasing a long breath.
pairs.hanzi: 她把靴子推过去，自己靠到椅边，用那只瘪枕头垫住腰，长长出了一口气。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià tiāo jié . dàizǐ gān le , xì ní kǎ zài fènglǐ , dé xiān róu sōng .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to pick at the knot. The lace was dry, fine mud lodged in its folds, needing to be rubbed loose first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下挑结。带子干了，细泥卡在缝里，得先揉松。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu chāi jiùyī , sè lā zǒng shuō liúxià xiàn , bié yìdāo dōu qiēduàn . yǎnqián zhègēn dài yǐjīng mómáo , nài lěi què réng kànzhe , xiàng tā míngtiān hái dé péi tā zǒu hěn yuǎn .
pairs.english: He remembered taking old clothes apart as a child, Sela always saying to save the thread rather than cut it all. The lace before him was frayed, but Nerai watched as though it still had far to walk with her tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起自己小时候拆旧衣，瑟拉总说留下线，别一刀都切断。眼前这根带已经磨毛，奈蕾却仍看着，像它明天还得陪她走很远。

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú jiěkāi , dìguòqù shí , tā cóng xuē tǒng lǐ dǎo chū yílì xiǎoshízǐ . " zǒu le yílù ? " tā wèn . " zuìhòu nà yíduàn . "
pairs.english: He finally untied it and handed it back. She tipped a pebble from the boot. “All the way?” he asked. “The last stretch.”
pairs.hanzi:
他终于解开，递过去时，她从靴筒里倒出一粒小石子。
“走了一路？”他问。
“最后那一段。”

pairs.target: " nǐ zěnme bù ná chūlái ? " " ná guò . tā yòu huíqù le . " tā shuō shítou búhuì zìjǐ zǒu , tā shuō nà nǐ qù wèn shítou . liǎnggè rén xiào qǐlái , wūlǐ nà diǎn shī pígé de qìwèi yě bú nàme chén le .
pairs.english: “Why did you not take it out?” “I did. It went back.” He said stones did not walk by themselves; she told him to ask the stone. Both laughed, and the room’s wet-leather smell felt less heavy.
pairs.hanzi:
“你怎么不拿出来？”
“拿过。它又回去了。”
他说石头不会自己走，她说那你去问石头。两个人笑起来，屋里那点湿皮革的气味也不那么沉了。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng fàng zhe tā jiāohuílái de chāo tú . nài lěi jiāng shízǐ yā dào yìjiǎo , wèn tā cóng shí zhuó huílái yǐhòu , zuì xiǎng xué shénme .
pairs.english: His returned drawing copy lay on the table. Nerai weighted a corner with the pebble and asked what he most wanted to learn after Stonewash.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上放着他交回来的抄图。奈蕾将石子压到一角，问他从石濯回来以后，最想学什么。

pairs.target: tā běnlái zhǔnbèi wèn jiù zhá de shì , huàdàozuǐbiān , xiān shuō zìjǐ bùxiǎng měi huí kànjiàn biéde tiě biàn le , jiù zhǐnéng cāi shìbushì gēn zhuōshàng nà liǎngpiàn yíyàng .
pairs.english: He had meant to ask about the old sluice, but instead said he did not want every change in other iron to leave him guessing whether it matched the two pieces on his table.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来准备问旧闸的事，话到嘴边，先说自己不想每回看见别的铁变了，就只能猜是不是跟桌上那两片一样。

pairs.target: " nà dé xuéhuì , nǎxiē quèshí búshì yíyàng . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Then learn which things truly are different,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “那得学会，哪些确实不是一样。”她说。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi tā yào zài náchū yìzhāng tú , nài lěi què cóng shū dǐ chōuchū yìzhāng kè dān , shuō bǎi lǎoshī guò liǎngtiān huì dài yìzǔ xīn kè , jiǎng rè zài cáiliào lǐ zěnme zǒu .
pairs.english: He expected another drawing, but Nerai pulled a course sheet from under a book: Instructor Bai would begin new classes in two days, on how heat travelled through materials.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为她要再拿出一张图，奈蕾却从书底抽出一张课单，说柏老师过两天会带一组新课，讲热在材料里怎么走。

pairs.target: búshì jiào rén píngkōng shāohuǒ , yě búshì yí shàng shǒu jiù néng zuò , xiān yào huì bǎ wàitou lái de rè hé zìjǐ gǎi de nà yìdiǎn fēnkāi .
pairs.english: Not creating fire from nothing, nor something to do at first touch: first one had to distinguish external heat from the small change one made.
pairs.hanzi: 不是教人凭空烧火，也不是一上手就能做，先要会把外头来的热和自己改的那一点分开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn kè dān shàng yǒu tóngpiàn hé shuǐcáo , jìng yǒudiǎnxiàng gāng jìn xuégōng shí , kàn shénme dōu bú rènde .
pairs.english: Seeing copper pieces and water troughs listed, Tavi felt a little like his first arrival at the academy, recognizing nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见课单上有铜片和水槽，竟有点像刚进学宫时，看什么都不认得。

pairs.target: tā wèn zìjǐ nà yítào mō tiě de bànfǎ shìbushì quán méiyòng , tā shuō yǒuyòng de bùfen búhuì diū , kě bùnéng yīnwèi huì yìzhǒng , jiù tì lìng yìzhǒng xiān diǎntóu .
pairs.english: He asked if his iron-touching method was useless; she said its useful parts would remain, but knowing one thing did not let him approve another in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 他问自己那一套摸铁的办法是不是全没用，她说有用的部分不会丢，可不能因为会一种，就替另一种先点头。

pairs.target: tā jiāng kè dān dúwán , cái xiǎngqǐ bāo lǐ de chāoběn . wū yà nà fēng huíxìn , tā hái méiyǒu jiǎng gěi tā tīng . zhècì tā náchū de shì fú lán de xìn , shuōmíng yuánjiàn liúzài sè lā nàlǐ , yòu shuō zìjǐ yǐjīng wèn guò dāngnián de shōuxìn chù , búhuì ná jiù dìzhǐ dāng tiānliàng jiù qù zhǎo .
pairs.english: After reading, he remembered the copy in his bag. He had not yet told her about Wuya’s reply. He produced Fulan’s letter, explaining Sela held the original and he had already asked about its old receiving place, without planning to rush there at dawn with an obsolete address.
pairs.hanzi: 他将课单读完，才想起包里的抄本。乌娅那封回信，他还没有讲给她听。这次他拿出的是芙兰的信，说明原件留在瑟拉那里，又说自己已经问过当年的收信处，不会拿旧地址当天亮就去找。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiēguò qù , xiān wèn tā xiǎng ràng zìjǐ kàn nǎ yíduàn . tā shuō dōu kěyǐ , tā cái zuò zhí , yìxíng yìháng dú . dú dào wǒ qù liǎnggè zì , tā tíng le yíhuìer , méiyǒu shuō rènhé xiàng rènchū rén dehuà .
pairs.english: Nerai took it and first asked which passage he wanted her to read. He said all of it; only then did she sit straight and read line by line. At “I will come” she paused, saying nothing that suggested recognition.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾接过去，先问他想让自己看哪一段。他说都可以，她才坐直，一行一行读。读到我去两个字，她停了一会儿，没有说任何像认出人的话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gàosù tā , zìjǐ xiǎng yǒu yìtiān zhēn qù yú wān , dàn bùxiǎng měi yítàng lù dōu zhǐshì zhuī zhe yìfēngxìn pǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi told her he wanted to go to Elmbay someday, but did not want every journey to be only chasing a letter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维告诉她，自己想有一天真去榆湾，但不想每一趟路都只是追着一封信跑。

pairs.target: tā zài hébiān hái kànjiàn xǔduō dōngxī , huítóu cái fāxiàn , lián nà dǔzhù zhe rén de gāoqiáng yuánlái shì shénme , dōu méi láidejí wèn .
pairs.english: He had seen so much by the river, yet afterward realized he had never even asked what that inhabited tall wall had originally been.
pairs.hanzi: 他在河边还看见许多东西，回头才发现，连那堵住着人的高墙原来是什么，都没来得及问。

pairs.target: " wǒ wèn le . " nài lěi shuō . tā táitóu .
pairs.english: “I asked,” Nerai said. He looked up.
pairs.hanzi:
“我问了。”奈蕾说。
他抬头。

pairs.target: " jiùhuò cāng de wàibì . hòulái pō shàng de ní yìdiǎndiǎn duīgāo , zuì xiàmiàn de mén xiān búyòng le . xiànzài lǐmiàn géchéng xiǎo jiān , zhù de rén zìjǐ bǔ chuāng . jùtǐ nǎyìnián gǎi de , wǒ méi chá . "
pairs.english: “The outer wall of an old warehouse. Slope soil gradually piled up, and the lowest doors fell out of use first. Now it is divided into rooms; the residents repair their own windows. I did not check the exact conversion year.”
pairs.hanzi: “旧货仓的外壁。后来坡上的泥一点点堆高，最下面的门先不用了。现在里面隔成小间，住的人自己补窗。具体哪一年改的，我没查。”

pairs.target: yuánlái búshì jùrén de wūzi . tǎ wéi què méiyǒu hěn shīwàng , fǎnér xiǎngqǐ dēng liàng shí chuāngyán nà zhī wǎn . nài lěi jiāng chāoběn jiāohuí tā , shuō xiàhuí ruò zài qù , yuè qín dàgài kěn dài tā kàn , zhǐyào bié gǎn zài rénjiā shōu chuán de shíhòu wèn .
pairs.english: So it was not a giant’s house. Tavi was not very disappointed, remembering instead the bowl on the lit windowsill. Nerai returned the copy, saying Yueqin might show him next time, provided he did not ask during boat handling.
pairs.hanzi: 原来不是巨人的屋子。塔维却没有很失望，反而想起灯亮时窗沿那只碗。奈蕾将抄本交回他，说下回若再去，月芹大概肯带他看，只要别赶在人家收船的时候问。

pairs.target: líkāi shí , tā bǎ kè dān chāo dào zìjǐ de běnzi lǐ , méiyǒu názǒu yuán zhǐ . nài lěi jiāng nà zhī jiěkāi dài de xuēzǐ līn dào ménwài , hūrán jiàozhù tā , bǎ gāngcái nà lì shítou rēngjìn tā zhǎngxīn . " gěi nǐ . huì zǒulù de . "
pairs.english: Before leaving, he copied the course sheet into his notebook, leaving the original. Nerai carried the unlaced boot outside, suddenly called him back and tossed the pebble into his palm. “Yours. It walks.”
pairs.hanzi:
离开时，他把课单抄到自己的本子里，没有拿走原纸。奈蕾将那只解开带的靴子拎到门外，忽然叫住他，把刚才那粒石头扔进他掌心。
“给你。会走路的。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wò zhe tā xiào le yílù . huí sùshè hòu , tā méishěde rēng , fàngdào běnzi pángbiān , pà pà wò wèn jià , xiān xiě le yì xiǎozhāng zhǐ : bú mài .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed all the way with it in his hand. Back at the dormitory, unwilling to throw it away, he put it by his notebook and, fearing Pavo would ask the price, wrote a small sign: not for sale.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维握着它笑了一路。回宿舍后，他没舍得扔，放到本子旁边，怕帕沃问价，先写了一小张纸：不卖。
